title: Parse or Fail
goal: Parse a slice of strings into a Result containing a vector of numbers.
hints: The map stage should produce Result values without unwrapping them.
The function return type asks for Result<Vec<i32>, ParseIntError>, so collect needs to construct a Result.
explanation: `.map(|s| s.parse::<i32>())` yields `Result` items without panicking on invalid input. `.collect()` sees the function return type `Result<Vec<i32>, ParseIntError>` and automatically converts the `Iterator<Item = Result<T, E>>` into a `Result<Vec<T>, E>`. Using `.unwrap()` inside `map` panics on invalid input instead of returning an `Err`. Calling `.collect::<Vec<_>>()` tries to return `Vec<Result<i32, ParseIntError>>`, which causes a type mismatch `E0308`. `.sum()` fails with `E0277` because `Result` cannot be summed directly.
